import json
from pathlib import Path
from assistant.infra.config import Settings
from assistant.infra.indexing import load_kb
from assistant.infra.grounding import find_codes, find_names
s=Settings.from_env()
g=load_kb(s).graph
expected=[]
for p in sorted((s.data_dir/'corpus').glob('manual_*.md')):
    text=p.read_text()
    models=[code for code in find_codes(text.splitlines()[0]) if code.startswith(('AR-','BZ-','GS-'))]
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if not line.startswith('- ') or 'поставщик' not in line: continue
        parts=[code for code in find_codes(line) if code.startswith('P-')]
        names=find_names(line,load_kb(s).vocabulary)
        for part in parts:
            for model in models: expected.append((p.name,'Model:'+model,'HAS_PART','Part:'+part))
            for kind,name in names:
                if kind in ('Component','Supplier'):
                    expected.append((p.name,'Part:'+part,'IS_A' if kind=='Component' else 'SUPPLIED_BY',kind+':'+name))
missing=[row for row in expected if not g.has_edge(row[1],row[3]) or g.edges[row[1],row[3]]['type']!=row[2]]
report={'method':'Compare explicitly listed manual inventory rows with graph edges; no changes to graph',
        'expected_relations':len(expected),'present':len(expected)-len(missing),'missing':missing}
(s.artifacts_dir/'inventory-coverage-v3.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
scripts.check_order_v3.py:
import json,os,subprocess,time
from dataclasses import asdict,replace
from pathlib import Path
import httpx
from assistant.infra.config import Settings,make_llm,make_erp
from assistant.infra.cli import Context,runner
s=replace(Settings.from_env(),erp_url="http://127.0.0.1:8101")
server_log=open('/content/erp-v3-confirm-server.log','w')
server=subprocess.Popen(['uv','run','uvicorn','erp.app:app','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','8101'],
    env={**os.environ,'ERP_FAIL_RATE':'0'},stdout=server_log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
try:
    for _ in range(40):
        try:
            if httpx.get(s.erp_url+'/health',timeout=1).status_code==200: break
        except httpx.HTTPError: pass
        time.sleep(.25)
    else: raise RuntimeError('Isolated ERP did not start')
    questions=[json.loads(line) for line in (s.data_dir/'questions_dev.jsonl').read_text().splitlines() if line]
    q=next(q for q in questions if q['expected_pending'])
    ctx=Context(s,make_llm(s),make_erp(s))
    pending=runner('agent',ctx)(q['question'])
    report={'question':q['question'],'isolated_erp':True,'unconfirmed':asdict(pending)}
    path=s.artifacts_dir/'erp-confirmation-v3.json'
    path.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    assert pending.needs_confirmation and pending.pending_action==q['expected_pending'],report
    assert httpx.get(s.erp_url+'/orders/SO-000001').status_code==404
    confirmed=runner('agent',ctx,confirm=True)(q['question'])
    orders=[step.result for step in confirmed.steps if step.tool=='create_service_order' and not step.error]
    report['confirmed']=asdict(confirmed)
    report['orders']=orders
    path.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    assert len(orders)==1,report
    order=orders[0]
    persisted=httpx.get(s.erp_url+'/orders/'+order['order_id']).json()
    assert all(persisted[key]==value for key,value in q['expected_pending']['args'].items())
    assert order['order_id'] in confirmed.text
    report['persisted_order']=persisted
    report['passed']=True
    path.write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('CONFIRMATION_AND_REAL_ORDER_VERIFIED',json.dumps(persisted,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
finally:
    server.terminate()
    server.wait(timeout=15)
    server_log.close()

import subprocess,json,time
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path('/content/llm-project-repro-v3'); original=Path('/content/llm-project/artifacts')
results=[]
commands=[['uv','sync','--frozen','--python','3.11'],['make','test','RUN=uv run','ARGS=tests erp/tests src/assistant'],['make','lint','RUN=uv run'],['make','index','RUN=uv run'],['make','eval-all','RUN=uv run'],['make','eval-extraction','RUN=uv run'],['uv','run','python','/content/check_order_v3.py']]
for cmd in commands:
    start=time.time();r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=repo,capture_output=True,text=True)
    row={'command':cmd,'exit_code':r.returncode,'seconds':round(time.time()-start,2),'output':r.stdout+r.stderr}
    results.append(row);print('CHECK',cmd,r.returncode,row['output'][-600:],flush=True)
    if r.returncode: raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
files=['graph.json','communities.json','eval_baseline.json','eval_extraction.json','eval_local.json','eval_global.json','eval_agent.json','erp-confirmation-v3.json']
equal={name:json.loads((original/name).read_text())==json.loads((repo/'artifacts'/name).read_text()) for name in files}
a=json.loads((original/'index_stats.json').read_text());b=json.loads((repo/'artifacts/index_stats.json').read_text())
a['llm'].pop('cache_hits');b['llm'].pop('cache_hits');equal['index_stats_excluding_cache_hits']=a==b
report={'code_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip(),'environment':'fresh cloud clone and fresh uv environment; saved LLM cache; isolated confirmation ERP','docker_verified':False,'commands':results,'equal_to_original':equal}
(original/'reproducibility-v3.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
assert all(equal.values()),equal
print('REPRODUCIBLE',equal,flush=True)
